instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

summary.en: Defines the key terms used throughout the Act, including employer, employee, occupier, principal, place of work, plant and substance.
summary.zh: 界定全法通用的关键术语，包括雇主、雇员、占用人、委托方（principal）、工作场所、设备及物质。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

summary.en: Every employer must ensure, so far as is practicable, the safety, health and welfare at work of all employees: safe plant and systems of work, safe handling and transport of plant and substances, information, instruction, training and supervision, safe workplaces with safe access and egress, a safe working environment with welfare facilities, and emergency procedures.
summary.zh: 雇主须在可行范围内确保全体雇员在工作中的安全、健康与福利：提供安全的设备和作业系统、安全搬运与运输设备和物质、必要的信息、指导、培训与监督、安全的工作场所及进出通道、安全并配有福利设施的工作环境，以及应急程序。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

heading.en: Duty of employer to formulate occupational safety and health policy
heading.zh: 雇主制定职业安全健康方针的义务

summary.en: Except where prescribed otherwise, employers must prepare and revise as appropriate a written OSH policy statement, including the organisation and arrangements for carrying it out, and bring it to the notice of all employees.
summary.zh: 除另有规定外，雇主须编制并适时修订书面职业安全健康方针，说明实施该方针的组织与安排，并告知全体雇员。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

heading.en: General duties of employers and self-employed persons to persons other than their employees
heading.zh: 雇主及自雇者对非雇员的一般义务

summary.en: Employers and self-employed persons must conduct their undertaking so that, so far as is practicable, non-employees who may be affected are not exposed to safety or health risks, and must give prescribed information to such persons.
summary.zh: 雇主和自雇者须在可行范围内确保其经营活动不使可能受影响的非雇员面临安全或健康风险，并须向其提供规定的信息。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

heading.en: Duties of an occupier of a place of work to persons other than his employees
heading.zh: 工作场所占用人对非雇员的义务

summary.en: An occupier of non-domestic premises used by non-employees as a place of work must take practicable measures to keep the premises, access, egress and any plant or substance provided there safe; persons with contractual maintenance or risk-prevention obligations are deemed to control those matters.
summary.zh: 非住宅场所的占用人如将场所供非雇员作业使用，须采取可行措施确保场所、进出通道及所提供的设备或物质安全；依合同负有维修或风险防范义务者视为对相应事项具有控制权。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

summary.en: Inserted by Act A1648. A principal must take practicable measures for the safety and health of its contractors, subcontractors, indirect subcontractors and their employees when they work under the principal's direction, including safe plant and systems of work, allocating sufficient time, budget and resources for construction work activities, information, training and supervision, safe workplaces and access, and emergency procedures.
summary.zh: 由 A1648 号修正法新增。委托方须对在其指示下作业的承包商、分包商、间接分包商及其雇员采取可行的安全健康措施，包括安全的设备与作业系统、为施工活动分配充足的时间、预算与资源、信息、培训与监督、安全的工作场所与通道，以及应急程序。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

heading.en: Duty to conduct and implement risk assessment
heading.zh: 开展并落实风险评估的义务

summary.en: Inserted by Act A1648. Every employer, self-employed person or principal must conduct a risk assessment for persons who may be affected by the undertaking and implement risk controls where the assessment shows they are required.
summary.zh: 由 A1648 号修正法新增。雇主、自雇者或委托方须对可能受其经营活动影响的人员开展风险评估，并在评估表明需要时落实风险控制措施。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

heading.en: Penalty for an offence under section 15, 16, 17, 18, 18A or 18B

summary.en: Breach of sections 15, 16, 17, 18, 18A or 18B is an offence punishable by a fine not exceeding RM500,000 or imprisonment up to two years or both (raised from RM50,000 by Act A1648).
summary.zh: 违反第15、16、17、18、18A或18B条即属犯罪，可处不超过50万令吉罚款或不超过两年监禁，或两者兼施（A1648号修正法由5万令吉提高）。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

heading.en: General duties of manufacturers, etc., as regards plant for use at work
heading.zh: 设备设计、制造及供应者的一般义务

summary.en: Persons who design, manufacture, import or supply plant for use at work must, so far as is practicable, ensure it is safe when properly used, carry out necessary testing and provide adequate information and revisions; installers must ensure erection or installation does not make the plant unsafe.
summary.zh: 设计、制造、进口或供应工作用设备者，须在可行范围内确保其在正确使用时安全，开展必要的测试并提供充分的信息及更新；安装者须确保安装方式不致使设备不安全。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

heading.en: General duties of manufacturers, etc., as regards substances for use at work
heading.zh: 物质制造及供应者的一般义务

summary.en: Persons who formulate, manufacture, import or supply substances for use at work must, so far as is practicable, ensure they are safe when properly used, test them and make adequate information on test results and safe-use conditions available.
summary.zh: 配制、制造、进口或供应工作用物质者，须在可行范围内确保其在正确使用时安全，进行测试，并提供关于测试结果和安全使用条件的充分信息。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

heading.en: General duties of employees at work
heading.zh: 雇员在工作中的一般义务

summary.en: Employees must take reasonable care for themselves and others, co-operate with the employer, wear or use the protective equipment provided and comply with OSH instructions; breach carries a fine up to RM2,000 or three months' imprisonment or both.
summary.zh: 雇员须对自身及他人的安全健康尽合理注意、配合雇主、穿戴或使用所提供的防护装备，并遵守职业安全健康指示；违反者可处不超过2000令吉罚款或三个月监禁，或两者兼施。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

heading.en: Duty not to interfere with or misuse things provided pursuant to certain provisions
heading.zh: 不得干扰或滥用安全设施的义务

summary.en: Intentionally, recklessly or negligently interfering with or misusing anything provided for safety, health and welfare under the Act is an offence (fine up to RM20,000 or two years' imprisonment or both).
summary.zh: 故意、鲁莽或疏忽地干扰或滥用依本法为安全、健康和福利而提供的设施即属犯罪（可处不超过2万令吉罚款或两年监禁，或两者兼施）。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

heading.en: Duty not to charge employees for things done or provided
heading.zh: 不得向雇员收费的义务

summary.en: Employers may not charge employees for anything done or provided under the Act or its regulations, such as required protective equipment.
summary.zh: 雇主不得就依本法或其条例所做或提供的任何事项（如规定的防护装备）向雇员收费。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

summary.en: Inserted by Act A1648. After informing the employer that there is reasonable justification to believe an imminent danger exists, an employee may remove himself from the danger or work if the employer fails to act, and must not be discriminated against for doing so. Imminent danger means a serious risk of death or serious bodily injury.
summary.zh: 由 A1648 号修正法新增。雇员在告知雇主其有合理理由相信存在迫在眉睫的危险后，如雇主未采取行动，雇员有权撤离该危险或停止该工作，且不得因此受到歧视。迫在眉睫的危险指导致死亡或严重身体伤害的严重风险。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

summary.en: Employers may not dismiss or disadvantage an employee for raising safety complaints, serving on or acting for a safety and health committee, or assisting an officer in an inspection or investigation; courts may order compensation or reinstatement.
summary.zh: 雇主不得因雇员提出安全投诉、担任或履行安全健康委员会职责、或协助官员检查调查而解雇或损害其利益；法院可责令赔偿或复职。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

heading.en: Notice of occupation of place of work

summary.en: Persons occupying premises as a place of work or undertaking prescribed activities must give notice to an officer with the particulars, manner and timing determined by the Director General; applies to prescribed places and activities.
summary.zh: 占用场所作为工作场所或从事规定活动者，须按总监确定的内容、方式和时限向官员发出通知；适用于规定的场所与活动。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

summary.en: Prescribed plant may only be installed after it meets the prescribed requirements and the Director General's written approval has been obtained.
summary.zh: 规定设备须符合规定要求并取得总监书面批准后方可安装。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

summary.en: Installed prescribed plant may not be operated without a certificate of fitness issued by an officer or licensed person after inspection; the certificate terminates when the plant is dismantled, repaired or damaged, and operating without one is an offence.
summary.zh: 已安装的规定设备未经官员或持牌人检验并签发合格证书不得运行；设备拆卸、维修或损坏后证书即告终止；无证运行属犯罪。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

summary.en: Prescribed plant must be inspected by an officer or licensed person at the prescribed intervals and manner, subject to prescribed fees.
summary.zh: 规定设备须由官员或持牌人按规定周期和方式进行检验，并缴纳规定费用。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

summary.en: Occupiers of places of work of a class specified by Ministerial order must appoint a competent safety and health officer exclusively to ensure compliance and promote safe conduct of work; one SHO per place of work unless the Director General permits otherwise.
summary.zh: 部长令指定类别的工作场所占用人须任命胜任的安全健康主任，专职确保合规并促进安全作业；除总监另行许可外，每名主任同一时间仅负责一个工作场所。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

summary.en: Inserted by Act A1648. Employers with five or more employees whose workplace is not in a gazetted SHO class must appoint an OSH coordinator; appointing an SHO satisfies this duty.
summary.zh: 由 A1648 号修正法新增。工作场所不属于须设安全健康主任类别、且雇员达五人或以上的雇主，须任命职业安全健康协调员；已任命安全健康主任者视为已履行该义务。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

heading.en: Establishment of safety and health committee at place of work

summary.en: Employers must establish a safety and health committee where forty or more persons are employed at the place of work or where the Director General directs, and must consult it on safety measures.
summary.zh: 工作场所雇用40人或以上、或经总监指示时，雇主须设立安全健康委员会，并就安全措施征询其意见。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

heading.en: Functions of safety and health committee
heading.zh: 安全健康委员会的职能

summary.en: The committee reviews safety measures, investigates matters raised as unsafe, attempts to resolve them and, if it cannot, requests a Director General inspection.
summary.zh: 委员会负责审查安全措施、调查被提出的不安全事项并设法解决；无法解决时可请求总监检查。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

heading.en: Occupational safety and health training course
heading.zh: 职业安全健康培训课程

summary.en: The Minister may require classes of persons to attend OSH training by a registered training provider; employers must ensure required training is completed before the person performs that work.
summary.zh: 部长可要求特定类别人员参加由注册培训机构开设的职业安全健康培训；雇主须确保相关人员完成规定培训后方可从事该工作。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

heading.en: Activities to be carried out by competent person and registered training provider
heading.zh: 须由胜任人员及注册培训机构执行的活动

summary.en: Activities listed in the Fifth Schedule may only be carried out by a registered competent person, and OSH training courses only by a registered training provider.
summary.zh: 第五附表所列活动只能由注册胜任人员执行，职业安全健康培训只能由注册培训机构开展。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

heading.en: Notification of accidents, dangerous occurrence, occupational poisoning and occupational diseases, and inquiry
heading.zh: 事故、危险事件、职业中毒及职业病的通报

summary.en: Employers must notify the nearest OSH office of any accident, dangerous occurrence, occupational poisoning or occupational disease that has occurred or is likely to occur at the place of work; medical practitioners must report prescribed occupational diseases.
summary.zh: 雇主须将工作场所已发生或可能发生的事故、危险事件、职业中毒或职业病通报最近的职业安全健康办事处；医生须报告规定的职业病。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

heading.en: Director General may direct inquiry to be held

summary.en: The Director General may direct an inquiry into the nature and cause of an accident, dangerous occurrence, occupational poisoning or disease.
summary.zh: 总监可指示就事故、危险事件、职业中毒或职业病的性质与原因开展调查。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

heading.en: Approval of industry codes of practice

summary.en: The Minister may approve and revise industry codes of practice giving guidance on complying with the Act; they may adopt codes, standards and specifications.
summary.zh: 部长可批准并修订行业作业守则，以指导如何遵守本法；守则可采纳相关规范、标准与技术规格。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

heading.en: Use of industry codes of practice in proceedings
heading.zh: 行业作业守则在诉讼中的使用

summary.en: In proceedings, an approved industry code of practice may be used as evidence of whether the relevant duty was complied with.
summary.zh: 在法律程序中，经批准的行业作业守则可作为判断相关义务是否已履行的依据。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

summary.en: An officer who considers a place of work, plant, substance or process likely to be dangerous may serve an improvement notice requiring rectification within a set period; where there is likely immediate danger to life or property, a prohibition notice stops its use until the danger is removed.
summary.zh: 官员认为工作场所、设备、物质或工序可能构成危险时，可发出改善通知，要求在规定期限内整改；如可能对生命或财产造成即时危险，可发出禁止通知，在危险消除前禁止使用。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

heading.en: Penalty for failure to comply with notice

summary.en: Failure to comply with an improvement or prohibition notice is an offence.
summary.zh: 不遵守改善通知或禁止通知即属犯罪。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

summary.en: Contravening the Act or its subsidiary legislation where no penalty is expressly provided carries a fine up to RM100,000 or one year's imprisonment or both, plus a daily fine for continuing offences (amounts raised by Act A1648).
summary.zh: 违反本法或其附属立法而未另定罚则者，可处不超过10万令吉罚款或一年监禁，或两者兼施；持续违法另按日处罚（金额由A1648号修正法提高）。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument_zh: 1994年职业安全与健康法（第514号法令）

heading.en: Liability of director, etc., of company, etc.

summary.en: Where a body corporate commits an offence, its directors, compliance officers, managers and similar officers may be charged with it and may be held guilty unless they prove the offence was committed without their consent and that they exercised due diligence.
summary.zh: 法人团体犯罪时，其董事、合规官、经理等类似人员可一并被控，除非证明该罪行未经其同意且已尽职尽责，否则可被认定有罪。

version: Updated text as at 1 June 2024 (incorporates Act A1648)

instrument: Occupational Safety and Health (Construction Work)(Design and Management) Regulations 2024 [P.U.(A) 147/2024]
instrument_zh: 2024年职业安全与健康（施工作业）（设计与管理）条例 [P.U.(A) 147/2024]

summary.en: The Regulations apply to every place of work where a construction project is carried out.
summary.zh: 本条例适用于开展建设项目的所有工作场所。

version: Gazetted 31 May 2024 (Malay text read)
currency_note: Paraphrased from the Malay gazette text; no English version was published on the DOSH page read.

instrument: Occupational Safety and Health (Construction Work)(Design and Management) Regulations 2024 [P.U.(A) 147/2024]
instrument_zh: 2024年职业安全与健康（施工作业）（设计与管理）条例 [P.U.(A) 147/2024]

heading.en: Duties of client in relation to project management
heading.zh: 业主（client）在项目管理方面的义务

summary.en: The client must make suitable arrangements for managing the project, including allocating sufficient time and resources, so that construction work can be carried out safely.
summary.zh: 业主须为项目管理作出适当安排，包括分配充足的时间和资源，使施工作业能够安全进行。

version: Gazetted 31 May 2024 (Malay text read)
currency_note: Paraphrased from the Malay gazette text; no English version was published on the DOSH page read.

instrument: Occupational Safety and Health (Construction Work)(Design and Management) Regulations 2024 [P.U.(A) 147/2024]
instrument_zh: 2024年职业安全与健康（施工作业）（设计与管理）条例 [P.U.(A) 147/2024]

heading.en: Pre-construction information and construction phase plan
heading.zh: 施工前信息与施工阶段计划

summary.en: The client must provide pre-construction information to designers and contractors and ensure a construction phase plan is drawn up before the construction phase begins.
summary.zh: 业主须向设计方和承包商提供施工前信息，并确保在施工阶段开始前编制施工阶段计划。

version: Gazetted 31 May 2024 (Malay text read)
currency_note: Paraphrased from the Malay gazette text; no English version was published on the DOSH page read.

instrument: Occupational Safety and Health (Construction Work)(Design and Management) Regulations 2024 [P.U.(A) 147/2024]
instrument_zh: 2024年职业安全与健康（施工作业）（设计与管理）条例 [P.U.(A) 147/2024]

heading.en: Appointment of principal designer and principal contractor
heading.zh: 任命主设计方与总承包商

summary.en: Where more than one contractor is or is likely to be involved, the client must appoint in writing a principal designer (controlling the pre-construction phase) and a principal contractor as early as practicable before construction starts; if it fails to, the client itself must carry out those duties.
summary.zh: 如有或可能有多于一个承包商参与，业主须在施工开始前尽早书面任命主设计方（控制施工前阶段）和总承包商；未任命的，业主须自行履行相应职责。

version: Gazetted 31 May 2024 (Malay text read)
currency_note: Paraphrased from the Malay gazette text; no English version was published on the DOSH page read.

instrument: Occupational Safety and Health (Construction Work)(Design and Management) Regulations 2024 [P.U.(A) 147/2024]
instrument_zh: 2024年职业安全与健康（施工作业）（设计与管理）条例 [P.U.(A) 147/2024]

summary.en: If construction work on site is scheduled to last more than thirty working days or exceed five hundred person-days, the client must notify the Director General in writing before the construction phase starts, display the particulars on site and keep them updated; breach carries a fine up to RM100,000 or one year's imprisonment or both.
summary.zh: 如现场施工计划超过30个工作日或500人日，业主须在施工阶段开始前书面通报总监，并在现场张贴相关信息并定期更新；违反者可处不超过10万令吉罚款或一年监禁，或两者兼施。

summary.en: Data controllers must process personal data in compliance with the seven principles: General, Notice and Choice, Disclosure, Security, Retention, Data Integrity and Access.

instrument_zh: 2010年个人数据保护法（第709号法令）

summary.en: Personal data may generally be processed only with the data subject's consent or on a listed lawful ground, for a lawful purpose directly related to the controller's activity, and must be adequate and not excessive.
summary.zh: 个人数据一般仅可在取得数据主体同意或具有列明的合法依据时、为与控制者活动直接相关的合法目的处理，且须充分而不过量。

version: Reprint as at 15 September 2026 (incorporates Act A1727; Malay text read)

instrument_zh: 2010年个人数据保护法（第709号法令）

version: Reprint as at 15 September 2026 (incorporates Act A1727; Malay text read)

instrument_zh: 2010年个人数据保护法（第709号法令）

summary.en: Data controllers and data processors must take practical steps to protect personal data from loss, misuse, modification, unauthorised or accidental access or disclosure, alteration or destruction, considering the nature of the data and where it is stored.
summary.zh: 数据控制者和数据处理者须采取切实措施，保护个人数据免遭丢失、滥用、篡改、未经授权或意外的访问或披露、更改或销毁，并考虑数据性质及存储位置。

version: Reprint as at 15 September 2026 (incorporates Act A1727; Malay text read)

instrument_zh: 2010年个人数据保护法（第709号法令）

summary.zh: 个人数据的保存时间不得超过实现目的所需，不再需要时须销毁或永久删除。

version: Reprint as at 15 September 2026 (incorporates Act A1727; Malay text read)

instrument_zh: 2010年个人数据保护法（第709号法令）

summary.en: Inserted by Act A1727. Data controllers, and data processors acting for them, must appoint one or more data protection officers accountable for compliance and notify the Commissioner; the appointment does not relieve them of their duties.
summary.zh: 由A1727号修正法新增。数据控制者及代其处理数据的处理者须任命一名或多名对合规负责的数据保护官并通知专员；任命不免除其自身义务。

version: Reprint as at 15 September 2026 (incorporates Act A1727; Malay text read)

instrument_zh: 2010年个人数据保护法（第709号法令）

summary.en: Inserted by Act A1727. A data controller that has reason to believe a personal data breach has occurred must notify the Commissioner as soon as practicable, and notify affected data subjects without undue delay where significant harm is likely; failure to notify the Commissioner is an offence (fine up to RM250,000 or two years' imprisonment or both).
summary.zh: 由A1727号修正法新增。数据控制者有理由相信发生个人数据泄露时，须尽快通知专员；如可能对数据主体造成重大损害，须及时通知受影响的数据主体；未通知专员属犯罪（可处不超过25万令吉罚款或两年监禁，或两者兼施）。

version: Reprint as at 15 September 2026 (incorporates Act A1727; Malay text read)

instrument_zh: 2010年个人数据保护法（第709号法令）

summary.en: Inserted by Act A1727. Data subjects may request transfer of their personal data to another data controller, subject to conditions.
summary.zh: 由A1727号修正法新增。数据主体可在一定条件下要求将其个人数据传输给另一数据控制者。

version: Reprint as at 15 September 2026 (incorporates Act A1727; Malay text read)

instrument_zh: 2010年个人数据保护法（第709号法令）

heading.en: Transfer of personal data to places outside Malaysia
heading.zh: 向马来西亚境外传输个人数据

summary.en: As amended by Act A1727 (the former Ministerial whitelist in subsection (1) was deleted), a data controller may transfer personal data abroad where the destination has law substantially similar to the Act or ensures an adequate level of protection at least equivalent to it, or where a listed exception applies such as consent, contract performance, legal proceedings or vital interests.
summary.zh: 经A1727号修正法修订（删除了原第(1)款的部长白名单机制），如目的地具有与本法实质相似的法律或能确保至少同等的充分保护水平，或适用同意、履行合同、法律程序、重大利益等列明例外情形，数据控制者可向境外传输个人数据。

version: Reprint as at 15 September 2026 (incorporates Act A1727; Malay text read)

instrument_zh: 2010年个人数据保护法（第709号法令）

heading.en: Unlawful collecting, etc., of personal data

summary.en: Knowingly or recklessly collecting, disclosing or procuring the disclosure of personal data without the data controller's consent is an offence.
summary.zh: 明知或鲁莽地在未经数据控制者同意的情况下收集、披露或促使披露个人数据即属犯罪。

version: Reprint as at 15 September 2026 (incorporates Act A1727; Malay text read)

instrument_zh: 2022年工厂与机械（废除）法（第835号法令）

heading.en: Repeal of the Factories and Machinery Act 1967

summary.en: Repeals the Factories and Machinery Act 1967 (Act 139). DOSH now lists regulations made under Act 139, including the 1986 building operations and works of engineering construction safety regulations, as repealed; construction-site duties are found in Act 514 and its 2024 Construction Work (Design and Management) Regulations.
summary.zh: 废除1967年工厂与机械法（第139号法令）。DOSH现已将依该法制定的条例（包括1986年建筑作业与工程施工安全条例）列为已废除；施工现场义务见第514号法令及其2024年施工作业（设计与管理）条例。

version: As published 16 March 2022 (Malay text read)

instrument_zh: 2022年工厂与机械（废除）法（第835号法令）

heading.en: Actions, etc., taken under the repealed Act
heading.zh: 依已废除法令所作行为的处理

summary.en: Registrations, orders, notices, permissions, certificates of fitness, special inspection schemes and certificates of competency issued under the repealed Act are dealt with under Act 514 from commencement, with listed notices continuing under the repealed Act.
summary.zh: 依已废除法令作出的注册、命令、通知、许可、合格证书、特别检验计划及资格证书，自生效起依第514号法令处理；部分列明的通知继续按已废除法令处理。

version: As published 16 March 2022 (Malay text read)

instrument_zh: 1955年雇佣法（第265号法令）

summary.en: The Act applies to Peninsular Malaysia and, by extension order, the Federal Territory of Labuan; Sabah and Sarawak are governed by their own labour ordinances.
summary.zh: 本法适用于马来西亚半岛，并经延伸令适用于纳闽联邦直辖区；沙巴和砂拉越适用各自的劳工条例。

version: Updated text as at 1 January 2023 (incorporates Act A1651); not an authentic reprint
currency_note: Applies to Peninsular Malaysia and Labuan; Sabah and Sarawak have their own Labour Ordinances.

instrument_zh: 1955年雇佣法（第265号法令）

heading.en: Contracts to be in writing and to include provision for termination
heading.zh: 合同须为书面并载明终止条款

summary.en: A contract of service for more than one month, or for a specified piece of work that may take more than one month, must be in writing and must state how either party may terminate it.
summary.zh: 期限超过一个月、或完成特定工作可能需要超过一个月的雇佣合同须以书面订立，并载明双方终止合同的方式。

version: Updated text as at 1 January 2023 (incorporates Act A1651); not an authentic reprint
currency_note: Applies to Peninsular Malaysia and Labuan; Sabah and Sarawak have their own Labour Ordinances.

instrument_zh: 1955年雇佣法（第265号法令）

summary.en: Wages less lawful deductions must be paid no later than the seventh day after the end of each wage period; overtime, rest-day and public-holiday pay by the last day of the next wage period, unless the Director General extends the time.
summary.zh: 工资（扣除合法扣款后）须在每个工资期结束后第七天之前支付；加班、休息日及公共假日工资须在下一个工资期最后一天前支付，经劳工总监批准可延期。

version: Updated text as at 1 January 2023 (incorporates Act A1651); not an authentic reprint
currency_note: Applies to Peninsular Malaysia and Labuan; Sabah and Sarawak have their own Labour Ordinances.

instrument_zh: 1955年雇佣法（第265号法令）

heading.en: Liability of principals and contractors for wages
heading.zh: 委托方与承包商对工资的连带责任

summary.en: Where wages are owed by a contractor or subcontractor for work under a contract, the principal, contractor and subcontractors are jointly and severally liable with the employer, limited to three months' wages and to claims made within ninety days; for constructional work the principal is liable only if it is itself a constructional contractor or housing developer.
summary.zh: 承包商或分包商拖欠合同项下工作的工资时，委托方、承包商和分包商与雇主承担连带责任，以三个月工资为限，且须在九十天内提出索赔；就建筑工程而言，委托方仅在其本身为建筑承包商或房屋开发商时承担该责任。

version: Updated text as at 1 January 2023 (incorporates Act A1651); not an authentic reprint
currency_note: Applies to Peninsular Malaysia and Labuan; Sabah and Sarawak have their own Labour Ordinances.

instrument_zh: 1955年雇佣法（第265号法令）

heading.en: Information relating to supply of employees
heading.zh: 劳务供应承包商的信息义务

summary.en: A contractor for labour must register with the Director General at least fourteen days before supplying employees, have a written contract with the principal, contractor or subcontractor it supplies, and keep registers of each employee supplied.
summary.zh: 劳务供应承包商须在供应劳工前至少十四天向劳工总监注册，须与接收劳工的委托方、承包商或分包商订立书面合同，并为所供应的每名劳工备存登记册。

version: Updated text as at 1 January 2023 (incorporates Act A1651); not an authentic reprint
currency_note: Applies to Peninsular Malaysia and Labuan; Sabah and Sarawak have their own Labour Ordinances.

instrument_zh: 1955年雇佣法（第265号法令）

heading.en: Hours of work and working at night

summary.en: Employees may not be required to work more than five consecutive hours without a 30-minute break, more than eight hours a day, a spread-over of more than ten hours a day, or more than forty-five hours a week, subject to listed exceptions.
summary.zh: 除列明的例外情形外，不得要求雇员连续工作超过五小时而无30分钟休息、每天工作超过八小时、每天跨度超过十小时，或每周工作超过四十五小时。

version: Updated text as at 1 January 2023 (incorporates Act A1651); not an authentic reprint
currency_note: Applies to Peninsular Malaysia and Labuan; Sabah and Sarawak have their own Labour Ordinances.

instrument_zh: 1955年雇佣法（第265号法令）

summary.en: Employees are entitled to paid holidays on eleven gazetted public holidays a year, five of which are fixed (including National Day, Malaysia Day and Workers' Day), and to holiday pay rules for work on those days.
summary.zh: 雇员每年享有十一个带薪宪报公共假日，其中五个为固定假日（包括国庆日、马来西亚日和劳动节），在这些日子工作须按规定支付假日工资。

version: Updated text as at 1 January 2023 (incorporates Act A1651); not an authentic reprint
currency_note: Applies to Peninsular Malaysia and Labuan; Sabah and Sarawak have their own Labour Ordinances.

instrument_zh: 1955年雇佣法（第265号法令）

summary.en: Paid annual leave is eight days for less than two years' service, twelve days for two to five years and sixteen days for five years or more, pro-rated in the final year.
summary.zh: 带薪年假为：服务不满两年八天，两年至不满五年十二天，五年及以上十六天；离职当年按比例计算。

version: Updated text as at 1 January 2023 (incorporates Act A1651); not an authentic reprint
currency_note: Applies to Peninsular Malaysia and Labuan; Sabah and Sarawak have their own Labour Ordinances.

instrument_zh: 1955年雇佣法（第265号法令）

summary.en: After examination by an appointed or other registered medical practitioner, employees are entitled to paid sick leave scaled by length of service (for example fourteen days a year for less than two years' service without hospitalisation), with additional leave where hospitalisation is needed.
summary.zh: 经指定或其他注册医生检查后，雇员可按服务年限享有带薪病假（例如服务不满两年且无需住院的，每年十四天），需住院的另有额外病假。

version: Updated text as at 1 January 2023 (incorporates Act A1651); not an authentic reprint
currency_note: Applies to Peninsular Malaysia and Labuan; Sabah and Sarawak have their own Labour Ordinances.

instrument_zh: 1955年雇佣法（第265号法令）

summary.en: Employers need the Director General's prior approval to employ a foreign employee and must furnish the employee's particulars within fourteen days of employment; approval requires no outstanding labour orders or convictions and no conviction for trafficking or forced-labour offences.
summary.zh: 雇主须事先取得劳工总监批准方可雇用外籍雇员，并须在雇用后十四天内提交该雇员资料；批准条件包括无未结的劳工命令或定罪，且无人口贩运或强迫劳动罪行定罪记录。

version: Updated text as at 1 January 2023 (incorporates Act A1651); not an authentic reprint
currency_note: Applies to Peninsular Malaysia and Labuan; Sabah and Sarawak have their own Labour Ordinances.

instrument_zh: 1955年雇佣法（第265号法令）

heading.en: Termination of employment of foreign employee
heading.zh: 外籍雇员雇佣终止的通报

summary.en: The employer must inform the Director General within thirty days when a foreign employee's service ends by termination, pass expiry, repatriation or deportation, and within fourteen days if the employee resigns or absconds.
summary.zh: 外籍雇员因解雇、准证到期、遣返或驱逐而终止雇佣时，雇主须在三十天内通知劳工总监；如该雇员辞职或擅离，须在十四天内通知。

version: Updated text as at 1 January 2023 (incorporates Act A1651); not an authentic reprint
currency_note: Applies to Peninsular Malaysia and Labuan; Sabah and Sarawak have their own Labour Ordinances.

instrument_zh: 1955年雇佣法（第265号法令）

heading.en: Prohibition on termination of local for foreign employee
heading.zh: 不得为雇用外籍雇员而解雇本地雇员

summary.en: An employer may not terminate a local employee in order to employ a foreign employee; under s.60N, in a redundancy all foreign employees in similar roles must be retrenched before any local employee.
summary.zh: 雇主不得为雇用外籍雇员而解雇本地雇员；依第60N条，裁员时须先裁减同类岗位的全部外籍雇员，方可裁减本地雇员。

version: Updated text as at 1 January 2023 (incorporates Act A1651); not an authentic reprint
currency_note: Applies to Peninsular Malaysia and Labuan; Sabah and Sarawak have their own Labour Ordinances.

instrument_zh: 1955年雇佣法（第265号法令）

summary.en: Employers must keep registers with the prescribed information on each employee and preserve each entry for inspection for at least six years.
summary.zh: 雇主须为每名雇员备存载有规定信息的登记册，并将每项记录保存至少六年以备检查。

version: Updated text as at 1 January 2023 (incorporates Act A1651); not an authentic reprint
currency_note: Applies to Peninsular Malaysia and Labuan; Sabah and Sarawak have their own Labour Ordinances.

instrument_zh: 1955年雇佣法（第265号法令）

summary.en: The Director General may inquire into and decide disputes about discrimination in employment and make orders; failing to comply with such an order is an offence with a continuing daily fine.
summary.zh: 劳工总监可调查并裁决与雇佣歧视有关的争议并作出命令；不遵守该命令属犯罪，持续违反另按日处罚。

version: Updated text as at 1 January 2023 (incorporates Act A1651); not an authentic reprint
currency_note: Applies to Peninsular Malaysia and Labuan; Sabah and Sarawak have their own Labour Ordinances.

instrument_zh: 1955年雇佣法（第265号法令）

summary.en: An employer who threatens, deceives or forces an employee to work and prevents the employee from leaving the work area commits an offence punishable by a fine up to RM100,000 or two years' imprisonment or both.
summary.zh: 雇主以威胁、欺骗或强迫手段使雇员工作并阻止其离开工作区域的，属犯罪，可处不超过10万令吉罚款或两年监禁，或两者兼施。

version: Updated text as at 1 January 2023 (incorporates Act A1651); not an authentic reprint
currency_note: Applies to Peninsular Malaysia and Labuan; Sabah and Sarawak have their own Labour Ordinances.

instrument_zh: 1955年雇佣法（第265号法令）

summary.en: Offences under the Act or its subsidiary legislation without a specific penalty carry a fine up to RM50,000.
summary.zh: 违反本法或其附属立法而未另定罚则的，可处不超过5万令吉罚款。

version: Updated text as at 1 January 2023 (incorporates Act A1651); not an authentic reprint
currency_note: Applies to Peninsular Malaysia and Labuan; Sabah and Sarawak have their own Labour Ordinances.

instrument_zh: 1955年雇佣法（第265号法令）

heading.en: Presumption as to who is an employee and employer
heading.zh: 雇员与雇主身份的推定

summary.en: Absent a written contract, a person is presumed to be an employee where another controls the manner or hours of work, provides tools, or the work is integral to or solely for the other's business, or regular payments form most of the person's income.
summary.zh: 如无书面合同，凡他人控制其工作方式或时间、提供工具、其工作属他人业务不可分割部分或仅为他人利益，或定期报酬构成其主要收入的，推定其为雇员。

version: Updated text as at 1 January 2023 (incorporates Act A1651); not an authentic reprint
currency_note: Applies to Peninsular Malaysia and Labuan; Sabah and Sarawak have their own Labour Ordinances.

instrument_zh: 1974年环境质量法（第127号法令）

summary.en: Occupying or using premises prescribed by Ministerial order, or using prescribed waste conveyances, without a licence is an offence.
summary.zh: 未持许可证占用或使用部长令规定的场所，或使用规定的废物运输工具，即属犯罪。

version: Commissioner of Law Revision reprint incorporating amendments up to 1 January 2006
currency_note: 2006 reprint: later amendments (including Act A1441 of 2012 and any later penalty changes) and the EIA Order 2015 [P.U.(A) 195/2015] are not reflected; penalty amounts are omitted for that reason.

instrument_zh: 1974年环境质量法（第127号法令）

heading.en: Restrictions on pollution of the atmosphere

summary.en: No person may, unless licensed, emit environmentally hazardous substances, pollutants or wastes into the atmosphere beyond acceptable conditions; burning trade wastes or releasing offensive odours counts as emission.
summary.zh: 除持证外，任何人不得以超出可接受条件的方式向大气排放环境有害物质、污染物或废物；焚烧生产废物或散发恶臭均视为排放。

version: Commissioner of Law Revision reprint incorporating amendments up to 1 January 2006
currency_note: 2006 reprint: later amendments (including Act A1441 of 2012 and any later penalty changes) and the EIA Order 2015 [P.U.(A) 195/2015] are not reflected; penalty amounts are omitted for that reason.

instrument_zh: 1974年环境质量法（第127号法令）

summary.en: No person may, unless licensed, emit noise beyond the acceptable conditions specified under s.21; continuing after a Director General notice attracts a daily fine.
summary.zh: 除持证外，任何人不得排放超出第21条所定可接受条件的噪声；收到环境总监通知后仍持续的，另按日处罚。

version: Commissioner of Law Revision reprint incorporating amendments up to 1 January 2006
currency_note: 2006 reprint: later amendments (including Act A1441 of 2012 and any later penalty changes) and the EIA Order 2015 [P.U.(A) 195/2015] are not reflected; penalty amounts are omitted for that reason.

instrument_zh: 1974年环境质量法（第127号法令）

heading.en: Restrictions on pollution of the soil

summary.en: No person may, unless licensed, pollute soil or land surface; establishing a refuse, spoil, rock or sludge disposal site that is offensive or harmful counts as pollution.
summary.zh: 除持证外，任何人不得污染土壤或地表；设立令人厌恶或有害的垃圾、弃土、弃石或污泥处置场所即视为污染。

version: Commissioner of Law Revision reprint incorporating amendments up to 1 January 2006
currency_note: 2006 reprint: later amendments (including Act A1441 of 2012 and any later penalty changes) and the EIA Order 2015 [P.U.(A) 195/2015] are not reflected; penalty amounts are omitted for that reason.

instrument_zh: 1974年环境质量法（第127号法令）

heading.en: Restrictions on pollution of inland waters

summary.en: No person may, unless licensed, discharge hazardous substances, pollutants or wastes into inland waters; placing waste where it may drain or be washed into waters counts as discharge.
summary.zh: 除持证外，任何人不得向内陆水体排放有害物质、污染物或废物；将废物置于可能流入或被冲入水体的位置即视为排放。

version: Commissioner of Law Revision reprint incorporating amendments up to 1 January 2006
currency_note: 2006 reprint: later amendments (including Act A1441 of 2012 and any later penalty changes) and the EIA Order 2015 [P.U.(A) 195/2015] are not reflected; penalty amounts are omitted for that reason.

instrument_zh: 1974年环境质量法（第127号法令）

summary.en: Open burning on any premises is prohibited, subject to exemptions by order; open burning means fire or smouldering in the open air not directed through a chimney or stack.
summary.zh: 除经命令豁免外，禁止在任何场所露天焚烧；露天焚烧指未经烟囱或排气管引导、在露天发生的燃烧或闷烧。

version: Commissioner of Law Revision reprint incorporating amendments up to 1 January 2006
currency_note: 2006 reprint: later amendments (including Act A1441 of 2012 and any later penalty changes) and the EIA Order 2015 [P.U.(A) 195/2015] are not reflected; penalty amounts are omitted for that reason.

instrument_zh: 1974年环境质量法（第127号法令）

heading.en: Report on impact on environment resulting from prescribed activities
heading.zh: 规定活动的环境影响报告（EIA）

summary.en: Anyone intending to carry out an activity prescribed by Ministerial order must submit an environmental impact assessment report to the Director General before the approving authority grants approval, and must not proceed until the report is approved.
summary.zh: 拟开展部长令规定活动者，须在主管机关批准前向环境总监提交环境影响评价报告，报告获批前不得实施。

version: Commissioner of Law Revision reprint incorporating amendments up to 1 January 2006
currency_note: 2006 reprint: later amendments (including Act A1441 of 2012 and any later penalty changes) and the EIA Order 2015 [P.U.(A) 195/2015] are not reflected; penalty amounts are omitted for that reason.

instrument_zh: 1974年环境质量法（第127号法令）

heading.en: Prohibition against placing, deposit, etc., of scheduled wastes
heading.zh: 禁止违规处置列明废物

summary.en: Scheduled wastes may only be placed, deposited or disposed of at prescribed premises, and may not be sent into, out of or through Malaysia without the Director General's prior written approval.
summary.zh: 列明废物只能在规定场所放置、堆存或处置；未经环境总监事先书面批准，不得进出口或过境马来西亚。

version: Commissioner of Law Revision reprint incorporating amendments up to 1 January 2006
currency_note: 2006 reprint: later amendments (including Act A1441 of 2012 and any later penalty changes) and the EIA Order 2015 [P.U.(A) 195/2015] are not reflected; penalty amounts are omitted for that reason.

instrument_zh: 1974年环境质量法（第127号法令）

heading.en: Penalty for offences not otherwise provided for

summary.en: Breaching the Act, its regulations or licence conditions where no specific penalty is set is an offence subject to the general penalty.
summary.zh: 违反本法、其条例或许可证条件而未另定罚则的，属犯罪，适用一般罚则。

version: Commissioner of Law Revision reprint incorporating amendments up to 1 January 2006
currency_note: 2006 reprint: later amendments (including Act A1441 of 2012 and any later penalty changes) and the EIA Order 2015 [P.U.(A) 195/2015] are not reflected; penalty amounts are omitted for that reason.

instrument_zh: 1974年环境质量法（第127号法令）

heading.en: Offences by bodies of persons and by servants and agents
heading.zh: 法人团体及其雇员、代理人的犯罪

summary.en: Directors, managers and similar officers are deemed guilty of the company's offence unless they prove lack of consent and due diligence; employers may be liable for acts of their employees or agents.
summary.zh: 公司犯罪时，董事、经理等类似人员视为有罪，除非证明其未同意且已尽职尽责；雇主可能须对雇员或代理人的行为承担责任。

version: Commissioner of Law Revision reprint incorporating amendments up to 1 January 2006
currency_note: 2006 reprint: later amendments (including Act A1441 of 2012 and any later penalty changes) and the EIA Order 2015 [P.U.(A) 195/2015] are not reflected; penalty amounts are omitted for that reason.

instrument_zh: 1991年铁路法（第463号法令）

summary.en: No railway may be constructed without the Minister's approval of a deposited railway scheme describing the system, routes and terminals, safety arrangements and fare and freight structure, with a route map; the authoritative Malay text limits this to Sabah, Sarawak and Labuan.
summary.zh: 未经部长批准已提交的铁路计划（说明系统类型、线路与终点站、安全安排、票价与运价结构并附线路图），不得修建铁路；具权威性的马来文本将此限于沙巴、砂拉越和纳闽。

version: Text as at 1 January 2006 (Laws of Malaysia, Attorney General's Chambers)
currency_note: Read from a private transcription of the AGC text. The Malay text is authoritative; its s.7 limits the railway-scheme Part to Sabah, Sarawak and Labuan. Railways in Peninsular Malaysia are regulated mainly under the Land Public Transport Act 2010 (Act 715), which is not yet in this library.

instrument_zh: 1991年铁路法（第463号法令）

heading.en: Approval of railway scheme and deposit of plans, sections, etc.
heading.zh: 铁路计划的批准及图纸存档

summary.en: The Minister may reject or conditionally approve a scheme; plans, sections and a book of reference are then deposited for public inspection, with three months for objections before final approval.
summary.zh: 部长可驳回或有条件批准铁路计划；之后须存档平面图、断面图及参考册供公众查阅，经三个月异议期后方作最终批准。

instrument_zh: 1991年铁路法（第463号法令）

heading.en: Removal of trees dangerous to or obstructing the working of a railway
heading.zh: 清除危及铁路运行的树木

summary.en: A railway company may cut down trees on other land that endanger or obstruct the railway, paying compensation where the tree pre-dates the railway.
summary.zh: 铁路公司可砍伐其他土地上危及或妨碍铁路运行的树木；如树木早于铁路存在，须给予补偿。

heading.en: Notice of felling or clearing of trees or jungle adjacent to railway
heading.zh: 铁路邻近伐木或清林须事先通知

summary.en: Anyone intending to fell or clear trees or jungle adjacent to a railway must give the railway seven days' written notice.
summary.zh: 任何人拟在铁路邻近地带伐木或清理丛林，须提前七天书面通知铁路方。

heading.en: General penalty for failure to comply with Part V
heading.zh: 违反第五部分的一般罚则

summary.en: A railway company that contravenes the licensing and opening provisions of Part V commits an offence (fine up to RM10,000 or up to five years' imprisonment or both, per the text read).
summary.zh: 铁路公司违反第五部分关于许可与开通的规定即属犯罪（依所读文本，可处不超过1万令吉罚款或不超过五年监禁，或两者兼施）。

heading.en: Notice of accident to be given

summary.en: Within twenty-four hours of a railway accident the station officer must notify the nearest police station and the railway company must send written notice to the Director General with a brief statement of the accident and injuries or damage.
summary.zh: 铁路事故发生后二十四小时内，车站负责人须通知最近的警局，铁路公司须向铁路总监发出书面通知，简述事故及伤亡或损失情况。

summary.en: The railway company must hold a committee inquiry into an accident's cause, unless the cause is clear or it accepts responsibility, and report to the Director General, who with Ministerial approval may appoint an investigation committee with power to summon witnesses.

heading.en: Maliciously obstructing or attempting to obstruct a railway
heading.zh: 恶意妨碍或企图妨碍铁路

summary.en: Placing objects on the track, moving rails or points, interfering with signals or other acts done with intent or knowledge that they may obstruct the railway or endanger persons is a serious offence (up to RM50,000 or twenty years' imprisonment or both, per the text read).
summary.zh: 在轨道上放置物件、移动钢轨或道岔、干扰信号或其他意图或明知可能妨碍铁路或危及人身的行为，属严重犯罪（依所读文本，可处不超过5万令吉罚款或二十年监禁，或两者兼施）。

heading.en: Transfer of adjudication functions from KLRCA to AIAC

summary.en: Act A1738 replaces references to the KLRCA and its Director with the Asian International Arbitration Centre and the President of the AIAC Court of Arbitration (ss.4, 12(6), 16(2), 19, 21, 23, 32-34, 39 and 40 of Act 746), and deems existing appointments to continue; it does not change the payment-claim, response, adjudication timelines or conditional-payment provisions.
summary.zh: A1738号法令将第746号法令中关于KLRCA及其主任的表述改为亚洲国际仲裁中心（AIAC）及AIAC仲裁院院长（涉及第4、12(6)、16(2)、19、21、23、32至34、39及40条），并规定既有任命继续有效；付款申索、答复、审裁时限及附条件付款等规定未作修改。
